name: Lamb Rogan josh
assumptions: Yield estimated from 1kg lamb plus other ingredients, typical for 4 adult main-dish servings of Indian curry.
Total time is sum of active prep (~30 min for chopping, frying, simmering start) plus 40-60 min covered simmer; rounded to 90 min as conservative midpoint estimate from instructions.
Greek yogurt confirms dairy (milk) allergen present.
Madras paste is a compound ingredient whose exact composition is unspecified; conservatively null for ambiguous allergens (e.g. possible fish, wheat, soy, sesame in some commercial pastes).
No explicit gluten sources (barley/rye/wheat) listed; Madras paste ambiguity leaves gluten-free as null rather than confidently true.
No substitutions or external data used; classification based solely on listed ingredients.
instructions:
Put the onions in a food processor and whizz until very finely chopped. Heat the oil in a large heavy-based pan, then fry the onion with the lid on, stirring every now and then, until it is really golden and soft. Add the garlic and ginger, then fry for 5 mins more.
Tip the curry paste, all the spices and the bay leaves into the pan, with the tomato purée. Stir well over the heat for about 30 secs, then add the meat and 300ml water. Stir to mix, turn down the heat, then add the yogurt.
Cover the pan, then gently simmer for 40-60 mins until the meat is tender and the sauce nice and thick. Serve scattered with coriander, with plain basmati or pilau rice.
